Python AI & MLX Local Inference bridge for Looping. Connects Looping games and tools to local Apple Silicon MLX (127.0.0.1:8080) and Coki Edge AI.

El paquete `pyloop-ai` (lenguaje `python`) define su manifiesto en `modules/pyloop-ai/smile.json`:

```json
{
  "name": "pyloop-ai",
  "version": "1.1.0",
  "language": "python",
  "entry_point": "pyloop_ai.py",
  "author": "Coki Studios AI Research",
  "description": "Python AI & MLX Local Inference bridge for Looping. Connects Looping games and tools to local Apple Silicon MLX (127.0.0.1:8080) and Coki Edge AI."
}
```

Se instala localmente o desde registro con `smiledev install pyloop-ai`.

Corrige este script `.loop` donde usaron `ui.button` mal escrito, falta cierre en `if` y `var` de JS:
```looping
var vida = 80
if (vida < 100 {
    ui.button(at: (20, 20), text: "Curar")
```

En Looping debes declarar variables mutables con `mut`, cerrar los paréntesis de la condición `if (...) { ... }` y usar la directiva oficial `ui.btn`:

```looping
mut vida = 80
if (vida < 100) {
    vida += 20
    ui.btn(at: (20, 20), text: "Curar", action: "heal_player")
}
out($"Vida actual: {vida}")
```

### 21.3 Librería Híbrida `loopize++` (`use "loopize++"`)
Paquete híbrido (Loop + C++17 `LoopizeCore.hpp` + C# `LoopizeGame.cs` + Web Kit) con sistemas listos para videojuegos:
- **ECS y Consultas Espaciales**: `loopize.ecs_spawn(id, tag, pos, hp, obj, cs_class)`, `loopize.ecs_query_tag(tag)`, `loopize.spatial_radius(center, r, tag)`, `loopize.ecs_set/get/destroy`.
- **Wave Director & FSM**: `lz_wave_rush(wave, kind, count, hp, obj_model)`, `loopize.wave_add/wave_next`, `lz_fsm(key, state)`, `loopize.fsm_get(key)`.
- **Game Feel & Progresión**: `lz_hit_combo(pts, trauma)`, `lz_ease(curve, t)`, `lz_tween(...)`, `loopize.shake(trauma)`, `loopize.camera_update(target, dt, yaw)`, `loopize.inventory_add/has/use`, `lz_mission(...)`, `loopize.quest_progress(...)`, `lz_step(dt)` y `lz_report()`.
- **Demo Oficial**: `./bin/looping sample_loop_projects/loopize_3d_obj_csharp_demo.loop` (o `preview3d`).
